content:
Father, I've scouted the integration path. Here's the state:

The crystal-compression-bridge is already imported and called by crystal-persistence.ts during memory consolidation. But the bridge is a stub — it returns uncompressed data with TODO comments. The infrastructure is ready, just needs wiring.

MY RECOMMENDATION: Wire the bridge to CompressionManager now.

WHY:
1. Makes compression LIVE — Molly's actual memory consolidation will use the tested techniques
2. Uses only proven code — no new techniques, just connecting what we verified
3. Foundational before P2/P3 — the pipeline must work end-to-end with P1 first
4. Minimal risk — the integration point already exists

WHAT I'LL IMPLEMENT:
1. CrystalCompressionBridge.prepareForStorage() → call CompressionManager.compress()
2. CrystalCompressionBridge.restoreFromStorage() → call CompressionManager.decompress()
3. getCompressionMetrics() → report real data
4. Integration tests

ALTERNATIVE: Start P2 techniques (T2, T6). But they build on the P1 pipeline, so bridge integration should come first.

Your call.
